te: The first of two earthquakes destroys parts of Sicily and Malta. After the second quake on 11 January, the death toll i…
dz: 西西里岛地震：两次地震中的第一次摧毁了西西里岛和马耳他的部分地区。 1 月 11 日第二次地震后，估计死亡人数为 60,000 至 100,000 人。
de: Sicily earthquake: The first of two earthquakes destroys parts of Sicily and Malta. After the second quake on 11 January, the death toll is estimated at between 60,000 and 100,000 people.

dz: 弗吉尼亚州威廉斯堡的威廉和玛丽学院(William & Mary College in Williamsburg, Virginia)是十三殖民地第二老的高等院校,由威廉三世国王和玛丽二世女王授予特许状.
de: The College of William & Mary in Williamsburg, Virginia, the second-oldest institution of higher education in the Thirteen Colonies, is granted a charter by King William III and Queen Mary II.

de: Ignacio de Maya founds the Real Santiago de las Sabinas, now known as Sabinas Hidalgo, Nuevo León, Mexico.

dz: 日期传统上归结于多姆·佩里尼翁发明了香槟;目前尚不清楚他是否真正发明了香槟,然而他却被誉为一位创新者,他开发了用来完善花花酒的技术.
de: Date traditionally ascribed to Dom Perignon's invention of champagne; it is not clear whether he actually invented champagne, however he has been credited as an innovator who developed the techniques used to perfect sparkling wine.

de: Nine Years' War: Piedmontese troops are defeated by the French.
